title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
summary: One user said the exposed data tied his home address and card number to every crypto wallet linked to his account, raising the risk of targeted scams.

title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
summary: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.
